item.title: $49.5 million to upgrade 34 kilometres of the Tanami
item.description: The new Tanami contract is part of a broader program of works across the Territory. Image: Adwo/stock.adobe.com The Australian and Northern Territory governments have awarded a $49.5 million contract to upgrade a further 34 kilometres of Tanami Road. NT business Exact Contracting has been enlisted to upgrade the road between Renehans Bore and Refrigerator Bore – an important freight, mining, pastoral and tourism route. item.title: Regional truck wash reopens after major upgrades
item.description: The problems plaguing the Euroa facility have now been resolved. Image: Strathbogie Shire Council The Euroa Truck Wash in north-east Victoria is open again after months of major upgrades. Strathbogie Shire Council announced the news on its Facebook page yesterday after the Boundary Road facility had to be shut down for nearly a year due to a pump design flaw. item.title: Daimler dealerships share top honours at glittering awards event
item.description: The RGM Maintenance team celebrates the Daimler Trucks Townsville win. Images: Daimler Truck Daimler Trucks Townsville and Daimler Trucks Perth have been named joint winners of the 2025 Daimler Truck Dealer of the Year at a glittering event in Melbourne.
